senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חָלַץ) [to surround, tie up (corresp. to b. h. צמת),]
to make final. Part. pass. חָלוּט, f. חֲלוּטָה permanently sold, irredeemable.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 9:4">Arakh. IX, 4</cite> <he>הגיע … היה ח׳ וכו׳</he> (Talm. ed. 31ᵃ <he>היתה ח׳</he>, read: <he>חלוטה</he>) when the last day … had passed and it (the house) was not redeemed, it was his forever …, for we read <he>לצמיתות</he> (<cite ref="Leviticus 25:30">Lev. XXV, 30</cite>); (Tosef. ib. V, 10 <he>צמת</he>). Arakh. l. c. <he>בראשונה … שיהא ח׳ לו</he> formerly the purchaser used to hide himself on the last day … in order that it might become his irredeemably; Sifra B’har ch. V, Par. 4 <he>שתהא חלוטה לו</he>.
<cite ref="Arakhin 31b:19">Arakh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>למי ח׳</he> to which (of the two buyers) did it belong finally?; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="H00995"><he>חֲלוּטִין</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to pass final judgment on a leper after probationary enclosure (Lev. XIII).
units: <cite ref="Zevachim 102a:1">Zeb. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>אני מסגירה ואני חוֹלְטָהּ וכ׳</he> I will lock her up, declare her a leper and discharge her.

senses.gloss: to pass final judgment, to make valid; to adjudicate. Y. Dem. VII, beg. 26ᵃ צריך להַחֲלִיט וכ׳ he must make the consecrating conditions valid by speech. Y. Keth. X, 33ᵈ bot. אי זה … להַחֲלִיט מַחֲלִיטִין which of them the court chooses to declare valid, it may &c.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:7">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> <he>שלא תַחֲלִיט להם וכ׳</he> lest thou surrender the country to them (through bad argument); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 110">Yalk. ib. 110</cite> (insert <cite ref="L00167"><he>להם</he></cite>). Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵇ top <he>גסות … היא הֶחֱלִיטָתוֹ</he> his haughtiness made Jerob. a confirmed sinner; a. e.

senses.gloss: to declare a person a leper. Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᶜ bot. מטמא ומַחֲלִיט declares him unclean and this a decided leper; ורבנן … ומַחֲלִיטִין and the Rabbis say, he must be examined as if it were a new case, but at all events they declare &c.—

units: <cite ref="Yoma 86b:17">Yoma 86ᵇ</cite> <he>תשובת המוּחֲלָטִין</he> the repentance of the confirmed sinners.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 6:1">Tosef. Naz. VI, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ בספק</he> one declared a leper from doubt; Y. ib. VIII, end, 57ᵇ; a. fr.
